name: 1978 Seiko Type II Quartz 7546-8080, chocolate sunburst
condition_notes:
Dial and hands are clean. Light hairlines on the case back and clasp, see photos 3 and 5. Crystal has one small mark at 2 o'clock you'll only find if you look for it.
Keeps time to within a few seconds a month.

hotspots.note: Light hairline on the bezel edge near 10 o'clock. Visible only at an angle.
Day wheel is kanji / English. Prints crisp, no spotting.
